summary: Resolved for the project's own authorised test accounts by Aadyant Neog's team-lead decision on 28 November 2026 (ADR-0012). This is not instructor or provider evidence. Live writes are not covered.
change_rule: Only a human may change state, through a reviewed PR that links the instructor or provider evidence, or a team-lead ADR that says plainly it is not instructor evidence. An agent, model output or environment flag cannot change it on its own. To revoke, set state to unresolved.
